result.note: Tests the first-ever presidential visit to North Macedonia with its ITEC and trade outcomes, and the EU status of the three countries on the tour.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, President Droupadi Murmu visited Skopje and met North Macedonian President Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova. Consider the following statements about the visit:
items: It was the first visit to North Macedonia by an Indian president.
The two sides agreed to double bilateral trade by 2030.
India agreed to double North Macedonia's training places under the Indian Technical and Economic Cooperation (ITEC) programme.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the leaders agreed to double bilateral trade without setting any deadline. India also welcomed North Macedonia's interest in three India-backed climate and infrastructure groupings, though no binding deals were announced.
questions.source: The leaders agreed to double bilateral trade, without setting a deadline.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, President Droupadi Murmu toured Moldova, North Macedonia and Romania. Which of these countries is already a member of the European Union?
questions.explain: Romania, the final stop of the tour, is already an EU member, while Moldova and North Macedonia are EU candidates. Murmu's stops in Moldova and North Macedonia were both firsts for an Indian president.
questions.source: Moldova and North Macedonia are EU candidates, while Romania, Murmu’s final stop, is already a member.
